utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Okay, so Saturday morning at the community hall — got it. Can you confirm the exact time when you know it?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll check the exact time and let you know as soon as I can. Saturday morning at the community hall is still the plan.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Eli — I’ll keep Saturday morning at the community hall open and wait for the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what do you need from the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just the basics — a screwdriver, duct tape, and maybe a wrench if you’ve got one.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ve got the screwdriver and duct tape handy, and I can check for a wrench too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Right, the repair drive — I think it’s for gathering tools and parts for the neighborhood fixes. I’m a bit scattered, so if you want, I can double-check the exact details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes, please double-check the details so I know it’s definitely still on.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I meant to bring that box of tools, but I may have left it by the door again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can swing by and check by your door, Oren. If it’s there, I’ll bring the tools over.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — I really appreciate it. If you find it, I owe you one.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I get everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I can check around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — that would really help. Please let me know if you hear the date, time, or what items they need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane — it’s going pretty well so far. We’ve got a good little crew, and I’m just trying to keep everyone coordinated.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Glad to hear it — need me to take on anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort the donated tools and set aside the ones we can lend out? That’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donated tools and set aside the ones we can lend out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the repair drive spots if you want—just tell me the first location and I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be a big help, Opal. Let’s start with the school parking lot first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — school parking lot is first. I’ll keep track of the rest as you go.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is still on for this weekend, and they’re really hoping for a good turnout. If you’ve got anything to donate, I can point you to the drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll spread the word and bring a few things by myself. Thanks for pointing me to the drop-off spot!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Quinn — that’d be wonderful! I’ll let you know if they need any extra help setting up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What’s the repair drive working on first?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard they’re starting with the broken porch steps and the streetlights.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good — do they need donations or volunteer help?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll help spread the word about the repair drive, and I’ll keep repeating the plan so everyone knows when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — that really helps. I’ll keep an ear out for any updates and pass them along too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the details and let folks know as soon as there’s anything new.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m getting the repair drive organized now. If you’ve got any items or can help sort donations, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I can help sort for a bit, and I may have one small item to donate.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Uli — thank you. Come by when you can, and we’ll sort it together; I’d be glad to take a look at your item too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice little turnout — folks are bringing tools, parts, and a lot of good will. If you’re heading over, I’d go earlier rather than later.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds sensible. I’ll head over early and keep to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good call — the early hours are usually the easiest for grabbing what you need. If you see the organizer, tell them I said the turnout’s looking pretty promising.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — we’re still on track for the repair drive, and I’m just repeating the plan to a few folks. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — appreciate the update. I’ll keep an ear out if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m in for the repair drive. Just tell me what’s needed, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Rey. I’ll write up what’s needed and bring it by soon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Uli. I’ll keep an eye out for your list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo — could you check the donation box by the community center and bring it to the repair drive table?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can do that. I’ll grab the donation box from the community center and bring it over to the repair drive table.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help get the repair drive going—want me to reach out to a few folks and see what they can contribute?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please—could you ask what they can contribute and when they’d be available? I’d like to keep track of the details before we set anything in motion.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll ask what they can contribute and when they’re free, then I’ll pass along the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a bit behind on the details, but I’m in if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — I’d really appreciate that. I’ll send you the details and we can sort out a task that fits your schedule.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good, Mara — send them over when you can. I’ll take a look and see what I can help with.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, hey Gus — how’s the repair drive going? I’ve been out running errands, so I’m a little behind on the latest.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Pretty good so far — we’ve got a few folks fixing up odds and ends, and I’ve got some tools on hand if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Nice, that’s great to hear — I’ll spread the word if I hear anyone needs tools or a hand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo—what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Just tell me what’s on the list, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit worried about the logistics—do we know where the repairs will be collected and who’s handling drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m not sure yet, but I can ask and get the drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that’d help a lot. Once you know, could you let me know so I can plan around it?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please save me a spot—I can bring a few supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll save you a spot. Thanks for bringing supplies—I'll let you know if we need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off times if that makes the repair drive easier.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be a huge help, Faye — thank you. I might need a little reminding, but I’d love to work around those times.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — I can send you a quick reminder the day before, and we’ll keep it around pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted. If you want, I can start a simple sign-up list and gather the first set of requests.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, Rosa — I’m happy to help spread the word once you’ve got the list started.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll put together the sign-up list and send it your way soon. Thanks, Nell; I really appreciate your help spreading the word.
